checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Hands supported by low blocks, front knee on a small pad; upright torso.
checks.feet: Front knee bent and shin angled across mat; opposite leg straight behind, top of rear foot near mat.
checks.movement: Supported upright pigeon: front knee bent with shin angled across mat, rear leg straight back, hands supported; static left-side demonstration.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Eight-second supported left pigeon hold; repeat opposite side separately.
